notes: Westwing (language=de): the SAME 61 positions with the SAME ids as language=en, but the German document carries no <jobDescriptions> content (~700 bytes per position against ~10,000), so the language parameter changes the text and not the identity; 2 kept (the same ids as the first and last of the English fixture). OWNERSHIP VERIFIED, EVIDENCE: PAYLOAD_FIELD (subcompany "Westwing Group SE"). ENDPOINT: https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/xml?language={code} (developer.personio.de: language is one of de, en, fr, es, nl, it, pt "depending on the languages available for the Career Site"; the feed must be switched on per company in Settings > Recruiting > Career page > Activations, support.personio.de). HOSTS: the .de and .com hosts served byte-identical documents for both tenants tried (sha256 equal), so they are aliases of one data set, not two regions. NO POSTING URL IS IN THE FEED; the posting page is https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/job/{id} (measured for westwing: HTTP 200, canonical https://westwing.jobs.personio.de/job/2814781?language=en; the personio tenant's own position 1834171 answered 404 on the same pattern). robots.txt of personio.jobs.personio.de: "User-agent: * / Allow: /". The docs state no rate limit or terms of use. A language the feed does not carry is NOT an error: language=xx answered the same 45,529 bytes as language=de, and the document without a language parameter equals language=en.
